reviewText:
Dr. Anderson has been our favorite dentist for years. He is friendly, very skilled, fast, puts us all at ease, and even makes us laugh.
This is why we are willing to drive 45 min. to keep him as our kids dentist!

Their office is clean, bright, and playful. And the hygienist were friendly.

If you found this review helpful, please like it so Google and I know. Thanks!
